Yesterday (2026-09-03) was an unusually dense AI-announcement day: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Astra, Microsoft shipped MAI-Transcribe-2, xAI opened Grok Bot to enterprises, IFM released the K2 Horizon open model family, and Nvidia agreed to acquire Hugging Face for ~$12.93B — all four AI-model announcements plus the acquisition are filed. Cross-checked every lane-agent 'correction' candidate against the actual data files before filing: the AI lane's proposed date refinements for OpenAI's whisper-1/gpt-4o-transcribe retirement (2027-02-26) and ICLR 2027 (2027-04-26 to 04-30), and the bigtech lane's proposed endDate additions for Qualcomm Snapdragon Summit 2026 and Meta Connect 2026, all turned out to already be recorded exactly as proposed — no update needed, so none were re-filed as no-op findings. Dropped several lower-confidence lane candidates before filing: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked 2027 (only rumor-tracker sourcing, not even a month-level signal beyond speculation), Google's already-past Pixel 11 launch (no forward calendar value), and six majors' Q3/Q4 2026 earnings-date estimates (Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta, Amazon, TSMC) — all sourced only to analyst-tracker sites (TipRanks, Wall Street Horizon, Investing.com) rather than the company's own investor-relations confirmation, several with conflicting estimated days across sources, which reads too close to inferring a date to file confidently.
